facts.value: Admission is guaranteed to the university, but not necessarily to your original major or program. You may request a deferment. Deferment may be granted for up to one year for most other students including international students on an F-1 visa. You cannot attend another college or university during your deferment.
If you defer and plan to return in a different semester than approved, contact Admission Services.

Common reasons include: Religious volunteer work, Volunteer service, U.S. military service, International military service (for U.S. or non-U.S. citizens), Student Visa Denial or inability to obtain a visa appointment, Financial or personal reasons.
Approval is required for scholarship deferment through Financial Aid and Scholarship Services.
Registering for classes means you agree to pay tuition and fees. You will not be dropped automatically if you don’t pay.
To withdraw, sign in to My ASU. Once you've withdrawn from your classes, click the 'Cancel' button.
By deferring your admission, you also cancel your housing assignment and your orientation appointment.
You will owe full tuition if you do not withdraw from all classes before the refund deadline.
